critique: The current render has broad sky hatching and basic mountain/water/granite blocking, but lacks detail in the snowy ridge, water texture, pine definition, and foreground boulder mass. The sky needs deeper cyan/magenta overprinting, the mountain ridge needs sharper peak definition, the water needs more current variation, the right-shore granite needs cluster refinement, the pines need fuller tree forms, and the foreground boulder needs accent marks.
strategy: Ordered regional refinement from background to foreground: deepen the sky, sharpen the mountain ridge, enrich water currents, define right-shore granite clusters, build shoreline pine forms, and add foreground granite accents.

assignments.brief: Add layered cyan and magenta hatching strokes across the upper sky to deepen the blue overprint and improve sky-to-ridge separation
Add black, cyan, and magenta path strokes along the ridgeline to sharpen peaks and suggest snow texture against the sky
Add cyan current paths, yellow highlight strokes, and black contour lines across the water surface to suggest movement and depth
Add overlapping black, cyan, yellow, and magenta ellipses and path strokes to define the large granite boulders rising from the water on the right side
Add black trunk paths and cyan/yellow polygon foliage layers to build fuller pine tree shapes on the right shoreline
Add black, cyan, and magenta ellipses and path strokes in the lower foreground to model the large boulder and final accent details
